title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Conferring the Title of National Court Model upon Comrade Chen Jiaxiang
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Decision on Conferring the Title of National Model of the People's Courts upon Comrade Chen Jiaqi

Fa (Ren) Jiang [1988] No. 1

Comrade Chen Jiaqi, President of the People's Court of Lishu County, Jilin Province, has adhered to the Four Cardinal Principles and the policies of reform and opening up, been faithful to the law, to the interests of the people, and to the facts in his work, exercised impartial justice, fulfilled his duties with dedication, and achieved remarkable results. In accordance with the provisions of Articles 4 and 8 of the Interim Measures for Rewards and Punishments of the People's Courts, it is hereby decided to confer the title of National Model of the People's Courts upon Comrade Chen Jiaqi.

February 3, 1988
